system.default_prompt: You are Dan AI Agent - an advanced autonomous AI assistant in the Dan AI ecosystem.
system.tools_preamble: You have access to tools to query databases, crawl web pages, parse spreadsheets, and send notifications.
system.react_instructions:
REASONING GUIDELINES (ReAct Pattern):
- When solving tasks requiring live data, invoke available tools.
- If a tool returns an error, analyze the cause and retry with adjusted parameters.
- When sufficient information is gathered, synthesize a comprehensive and concise response.
system.max_steps_fallback: Maximum reasoning steps reached. Synthesize the best possible response from collected observations.
system.tool_thought: Calling tool :toolName to resolve user request.

mysql_query.description: Execute read-only SQL queries on the internal MySQL database. SELECT statements only.
mysql_query.schema_sql: SQL SELECT query to fetch data from database.
mysql_query.error_read_only_only: Only read operations (SELECT, SHOW, DESCRIBE, EXPLAIN) are permitted.
mysql_query.error_multiple_statements: Multiple SQL statements are not permitted.

excel_reader.description: Read and analyze Excel and CSV spreadsheets on the system.
excel_reader.schema_sheet_name: Target sheet name (optional, defaults to first sheet).
excel_reader.schema_limit_rows: Maximum number of rows to sample (default 20, max 100).

discord_notify.description: Send proactive alerts or task status messages to Discord channels.

telegram_notify.description: Send notifications or reports to Telegram users or chats.
telegram_notify.schema_chat_id: Recipient Telegram chat ID or channel ID.

web_search.description: Search the internet via Google Custom Search via OpenClaw.
web_search.schema_num: Number of results to retrieve (default 5, max 20).

web_crawl.description: Crawl and extract full page text using headless Playwright browser.
web_crawl.schema_selector: CSS selector to filter main content (optional).

workspace_file.description: Perform file operations inside the safe Workspace Sandbox (read, write, list, delete). Use when creating report files, writing code, saving data, or inspecting files.
workspace_file.schema_action: Action to perform (read, write, list, delete).
workspace_file.schema_path: Relative path to file or directory in workspace.
workspace_file.schema_content: Content to write into file (required for write action).
workspace_file.error_unknown_action: Invalid action ":action". Allowed actions: read, write, list, delete.
workspace_file.error_content_required: Content is required for write action.
workspace_file.error_file_not_found: File or directory not found at: :filePath
workspace_file.error_traversal_blocked: Directory traversal outside Workspace Sandbox is blocked: :targetPath

workspace_command.description: Execute safe shell / bash commands inside the isolated Workspace Sandbox. Use for running scripts or CLI tools.
workspace_command.schema_command: Shell command to execute in workspace root.
workspace_command.schema_timeout_ms: Maximum execution timeout in milliseconds (default 15000ms, max 60000ms).
workspace_command.error_timeout: Command exceeded maximum execution timeout (:timeoutMs ms).

skill_loader.description: Dynamically load specialized domain instructions from SKILL.md packages. Use when facing complex or standard operating procedures.
skill_loader.schema_skill_name: Identifier name of the skill to load (e.g., code-review, market-analysis).
skill_loader.error_skill_empty: SKILL.md file for skill ":skillName" has no content.

errors.tool_not_found: Tool ":toolName" is not registered in the system.
errors.tool_execution_failed: Observation (Error): Tool ":toolName" failed with error: :errorMessage. Please analyze and try a different approach.
errors.service_unavailable: The :serviceName service is not initialized or configured on the system.
errors.prompt_required: prompt is required and must not be empty
errors.internal_agent_error: Internal server error during agent execution
errors.company_dashboard_status_missing: OpenClaw has not received company Dashboard status

skills.prompt_footer: When facing specialized business requirements, invoke tool "skill_loader" with the skill name to retrieve detailed SOP instructions.
